rule.title: W-2 from Riverside Pediatric Group LLC is for 2025, not 2026
rule.detail: The upload reports calendar year 2025. It does not count toward the 2026 list; the 2026 form is still needed.

checklist.note: 2026 W-2 Copy B from Brightline Logistics. Box 1 is $97,800 (prior year $94,200, +3.8%). Box 2 is $11,310 and Box 12a D is $6,000. No large changes.

checklist.note: The uploaded W-2 is for tax year 2025 (rule check), so it does not satisfy this row. The 2026 W-2 from Riverside Pediatric Group is still needed.

checklist.note: 2026 1099-INT from Lakeshore FCU. Box 1 is $1,380 against $412 last year (+235%), flagged for the preparer.

checklist.source: Schedule B lines 1 and 5, Schedule D lines 1a, 8a and 13; last year's upload 1099-composite-harborpoint-2025.pdf
checklist.note: No 2026 composite 1099 from Harbor Point Securities (joint account ending 3391) has been uploaded.

No 2026 1098 from Keystone Home Lending. A new 1098 from Summit Ridge Mortgage (originated 2026-07-15, same property) suggests the Keystone loan was refinanced mid-year, so Keystone's 1098 for Jan–Jul 2026 is still needed.
The client must confirm which of the four $500 2026 estimated payments were made, with the date, amount and method of each.
The preparer must verify that the $1,000 2025 overpayment was posted to the 2026 account before counting it as a payment.
Maya turns 17 on 2026-05-21. The preparer decides how she is treated for 2026.

extras.text: Refinance treatment and itemize-vs-standard decision The preparer must decide the treatment of any refinance points or fees once the closing disclosure arrives, and whether to itemize when both 1098s are in. The 2025 return used the standard deduction. mortgage statement 1098.pdf: Box 6 blank, only one borrower TIN shown (ending 4821), Box 10 $3,290. Intake E5 note on the standard deduction.
